title: Towards Embodied Air-Ground Cooperative Object Search: Benchmark, Dataset and Agentic Method
abstract: arXiv:2609.08402v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Air-Ground Object Search (AGOS) in urban environments is a challenging embodied task, which requires an Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) and an Unmanned Ground Vehicle (UGV) to jointly search for and verify a specified target vehicle from multi-view visual references. To study this underexplored problem, we introduce AGOS-Bench, the first dedicated benchmark for evaluating whether general-purpose Vision-Language Models (VLMs) can integrate aerial discoveries and ground-level verification through UAV-UGV cooperation. We further provide AGOS-Dataset as the companion resource of exemplary trajectories constructed by an automatic pipeline. It consists of 7.7k episodes for searching objects of diverse categories and attributes, spanning three difficulty levels. To address the AGOS task, we propose AGOS-Agent, a training-free and tool-augmented approach. The agentic method relieves VLMs from complex and dynamic coordination via a deliberate sea

translated_title: 面向具身空地协同目标搜索：基准、数据集与智能体方法
translated_abstract: 城市环境中的空地目标搜索（AGOS）是一项具有挑战性的具身任务，它需要无人飞行器（UAV）与无人地面车辆（UGV）协同从多视角视觉参考中搜索并验证指定的目标车辆。为研究这一尚未充分探索的问题，我们提出了AGOS-Bench，这是首个专门评估通用视觉-语言模型（VLMs）能否通过UAV-UGV协作整合空中发现与地面验证的基准。我们进一步提供了AGOS-Dataset作为配套资源，该数据集由自动化流程构建的示例轨迹组成，包含7.7k个用于搜索多样化类别与属性目标的情节，涵盖三个难度级别。为解决AGOS任务，我们提出了AGOS-Agent，一种无需训练且工具增强的方法。该智能体方法通过审慎的搜索规划，使视觉-语言模型摆脱复杂而动态的协调负担。
tldr: 该论文提出了首个空地协同目标搜索基准AGOS-Bench、包含7.7k条轨迹的AGOS-Dataset数据集，以及无需训练、工具增强的智能体方法AGOS-Agent，用以评估和解决视觉-语言模型在UAV-UGV协作搜索与验证目标车辆任务中的难题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces AGOS-Bench, the first dedicated benchmark for air-ground cooperative object search, along with the AGOS-Dataset of 7.7k trajectories and a training-free, tool-augmented agentic method AGOS-Agent, to evaluate and enable VLMs to integrate aerial discoveries and ground-level verification in UAV-UGV cooperative target vehicle search.
